insights.body: For All App, App Total New Subs in JP is -25.0% while all countries together are +8.6% — a gap of -33.6pp. JP is about 7% of revenue, so it is big enough to be worth a look.

insights.title: Purchase type by country — Subscription revenue is falling most in DE (-18.5%), while US grows (+3.2%).
insights.body: By country: the biggest Subscription fall is DE -900 (-18.5%, about 5% of revenue); the biggest Subscription gain is US +1,054 (+3.2%); Pay as you go moved most in JP +910 (+68.2%); JP relies most on Pay as you go (37% of its revenue vs 6.2% overall). Subscription is the recurring revenue that new subs feed; Pay as you go is one-off spend.

insights.title: Next period outlook — Expect App Total Revenue to recover in about 7 days — more of the people installing are subscribing, mostly YMK.
insights.body: App Total New Subs is +8.6% while App Total Install is only -17.1% — a bigger share of people who installed are subscribing than usual (+25.6pp more growth). New subs start as 7-day free trials, so today's new subs are next period's App Total Revenue. So expect App Total Revenue to go up in about 7 days. App Total Revenue is -1.1% right now, so this points to a recovery rather than more weakness. Most of the increase comes from YMK (+32.9%); YCP is -29.3%.

insights.title: Revenue vs new subs — App Total Revenue +10.5% — up in line with the new subs signed up 7 days earlier (+14.5%).
insights.body: App Total Revenue on 11-02 vs 10-26 is +10.5%, and App Total New Subs on 10-26 vs 10-19 was +14.5% — both moved the same way. Most new subs start as a 7-day free trial, so the subscription revenue landing now mostly comes from people who subscribed about 7 days ago. By purchase type (on 11-02 vs 10-26): Subscription +9.1%, Pay as you go +35.0%. This is the normal pattern, so no surprise is building up.

insights.title: Installs to subs, by app — YCP is turning installs into New Subs better than usual (-29.3% vs Install -95.3%).
insights.body: Some apps are not converting installs into subscribers at their usual rate: YCP New Subs -29.3% vs Install -95.3% (better than its installs); YMK New Subs +32.9% vs Install +18.3% (better than its installs). Revenue follows about a week later, so these are the apps to watch next week.

insights.title: Best and worst markets — YCP turns installs into new subs best of anywhere (165.5% vs 14.3% overall).
insights.body: In YCP, 165.5% of installs turn into new subs, versus 14.3% across all markets and apps (+151.1pp difference). That is much better than the rest — worth understanding and copying. YCP is about 37% of revenue. Its App Total New Subs is -29.3% this period.
